stemMd: Events A and B cannot occur together and have probabilities 0.2 and 0.35. What is the probability that either occurs?
explanationMd: Mutually exclusive events have zero overlap. Their union probability is the sum, 0.2+0.35=0.55, with no intersection to subtract.

distractorRationale.a: This multiplies probabilities, appropriate to a different question and assumptions.
distractorRationale.c: This is the complement of the union.
distractorRationale.e: This doubles only one event probability.
